secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key (pk_test_/pk_live_) — required; without it every route 500s (ClerkProvider + proxy.ts middleware).

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key (sk_test_/sk_live_) — required alongside the publishable key.

secrets.name: TMDB_API_Read_Access_Token
secrets.description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token (themoviedb.org → Settings → API). TMDB_API_Key is the v3 alternative. The app boots without it, but media detail pages (/media/...) throw without a TMDB credential.

secrets.name: COLLECTION_MANAGER_CLERK_ID
secrets.description: Clerk user id (user_…) of the account allowed to manage collections at /dashboard/collections. Optional; leave unset to keep the manager workspace locked.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
secrets.description: Sentry DSN for error monitoring. Optional; unset disables Sentry cleanly.
